learning_objective: 🎯 We will meet the 26 magical letters of the English Alphabet family from A to Z!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The English alphabet is a big happy family of 26 letters! They always stand in a straight line starting from A and ending at Z.
Every letter has two cute shapes. One is a Big letter called Capital. The other is a Small letter. Big A and small a are best friends!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Play Dough Letters
fun_activity.instructions: Take some colorful play dough or clay. Ask your parents to help you roll it and make the very first letter of your lovely name!

quick_recap: ⭐ There are 26 beautiful letters in the English alphabet.
⭐ A is the very first letter and Z is the last letter.
⭐ Letters can be big like an elephant or small like an ant!
